title: How many balloons to lift a person
headline: HOW MANY BALLOONS
TO LIFT A PERSON?

lines.text: How many balloons does it take to lift a person?
One party balloon lifts about ten grams. So a cat? 450.
lines.note: Standard 11-inch latex balloon · about 10 g of lift (manufacturer chart) · 4.5 kg cat
A 70 kg adult · bigger balloons lift more

lines.text: A blue whale, the biggest animal alive? 15 million.
lines.note: NOAA: blue whales weigh up to about 150 tonnes

lines.text: And the Titanic? Over 5 billion balloons.
Filling them takes over 40 percent of all the helium the world produces in a year.
lines.note: About 75 million m³ of helium vs ~173 million m³ world output (USGS, 2023)

lines.text: Which is why the Titanic is still down there.
